skills.name: Bear Trap
skills.text: Set a bear trap within {range} tiles. The first foe to step on it takes {dmg} damage, is Rooted for {rootTurns} turns and gains {bleed} Bleed stack. Up to {cap} traps stand at once.

variants.name: Silvered Jaws
variants.text: The trap deals {unholyPct}% more damage to Unholy foes.

variants.name: Chained
variants.text: The trap's chain drags its victim {pull} tile toward you.

skills.name: Fieldcraft
skills.text: Your traps are hidden from foes and deal {trapDmgPct}% more damage. At ranks 3 and 5 you may set one more trap.

skills.name: Bola
skills.text: Throw a weighted bola at a foe within {range} tiles: it is knocked back {knockback} tiles and Slowed for {slowTurns} turns.

variants.name: Tangle
variants.text: The foe is Rooted for {rootTurns} turns instead of Slowed.

variants.name: Shatter
variants.text: A foe knocked into a wall is Stunned for {stunTurns} turns.

variants.name: Wide
variants.text: The bola spins through a {coneTiles}-tile cone, catching every foe in it.

skills.name: Salt Line
skills.text: Pour a line of salt up to {range} tiles long that lasts {turns} turns. Unholy foes cannot cross it, and any other foe that crosses is Slowed for {slowTurns} turns.

variants.name: Circle
variants.text: Pour the salt in a ring of radius {ringRadius} around you instead.

variants.name: Burning Salt
variants.text: Foes crossing the line take {dmg} Fire damage.

skills.name: Gibbet Net
skills.text: Hurl a weighted net at a cell within {range} tiles: every foe within {radius} tile of it is Rooted for {rootTurns} turns.

variants.name: Weighted
variants.text: Netted foes are also Vulnerable for {turns} turns.

variants.name: Snaring Ground
variants.text: The net stays spread for {turns} turns and snares every foe that walks into it.

skills.name: Predator
skills.text: You deal {dmgPct}% more damage to foes that are Rooted, Slowed or Stunned.

skills.name: Killing Ground
skills.text: Mark out a 3x3 killing ground within {range} tiles for {turns} turns: traps inside it trigger {triggers} times, and foes inside are Vulnerable.

variants.name: Ambush
variants.text: While you stand inside, you are hidden from foes.

variants.name: Pit
variants.text: Foes inside gain {bleed} Bleed stack each turn.

variants.name: Chain Reaction
variants.text: A trap triggered inside sets off the traps beside it.

skills.name: Lie in Wait
skills.text: Attacks made from stealth deal {dmgPct}% more damage and Stun the foe for {stunTurns} turn.

strings.tree.desc: Choose the ground, then make your foes walk into it: traps, nets and lines of salt.
strings.trap.bear_trap.name: Bear Trap
strings.trap.bear_trap.desc: Iron jaws hidden in the dirt. They bite and hold whatever steps on them.
strings.zone.salt_line.name: Salt Line
strings.zone.salt_line.desc: A line of consecrated salt. The Unholy cannot cross it, and others are slowed.
strings.zone.snaring_net.name: Snaring Net
strings.zone.snaring_net.desc: A net spread on the ground. It tangles anything that walks into it.
strings.zone.killing_ground.name: Killing Ground
strings.zone.killing_ground.desc: Ground chosen for a slaughter. Traps here strike twice, and those caught inside are exposed.
strings.refuse.no_trap_cell: A trap cannot be set there.
strings.refuse.no_salt: There is no room for a line of salt there.
